messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Nightingale Labs onboarding is showing a growing tail for long-context queries (p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.2s) and token spend is higher than expected for their summary workflow. Theyre concerned about renewal if we dont hit their SLOs. Any quick proactive perf recs we can push as a small canary?

lucas_ml: +1. Two low-risk moves: 1) try int8 quantization profile (minimal quality delta on summaries), 2) route long-context/high-token requests to a compact model variant for canary. Also prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts will shave a lot off p95.

raj_sre: Do we have the percentile breakdown and a sample trace? I can scope routing rules and a canary pool. What are their SLO targets?

maria_cs: SLO target is p95 < 300ms for interactive flows, cost per 1k tokens needs -20% ideally. Quick stats from last 24h: p50 120ms, p95 420ms, p99 1200ms, avg token length ~850. Logs: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/nightingale/logs?q=account:nightingale last24h

lucas_ml: ok. Proposed canary plan (keeps production intact + automatic fallback):

```yaml
canary: nightingale-compact-quant-1
steps:
  - percentage: 5
    model: redwood/compact-v2
    quant: int8_profile_B
    cache_prefix: true
    fallback: redwood/llm-standard
  - pause: 2h
  - percentage: 25
    model: redwood/compact-v2
    quant: int8_profile_B
    fallback: redwood/llm-standard
metrics:
  - p95_latency
  - quality_delta: "summary_rouge: <= 0.8%"
```

This gives us a staged swap with automatic fallback if quality or latency regress. Also add routing rule to send anything over 1k tokens to the canary pool during the test window.

emma_success: schedule an enablement call with Nightingale engineering to align expectations and capture acceptance criteria. If we dont get measurable improvement within 72h theres a medium renewal risk — loop in account exec.

maria_cs: can do. Client contact is taylor@nightingale.ai, available Mon/Tue 10-12 PT. Ill set the call. Also need one-pager that explains expected quality delta, rollback plan, and cost impact.

lucas_ml: putting together a 1-page playbook. Link (draft): https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/playbooks/compact-quant-canary (will attach final by EOD).

raj_sre: Ill create the routing rule and spin up a 5% dedicated canary pool. Config Ill apply: 

```json
{"route_policy":"token_length_based","threshold":1000,"destination":"nightingale-compact-quant-1","fallback":"llm-standard"}
```

ops-bot: Canary job "nightingale-compact-quant-1" scheduled by raj_sre. Start: 4678904800 (epoch), monitoring hooks and alerts attached. :rocket:

emma_success: Great. Capture qualitative feedback during the call (client trust, perceived latency) and add any counterexamples to their prompt eval set. Well use that to tune quant profile and fallback rules. :eyes:

maria_cs: Thanks team — next steps: 1) enablement call Mon 10:00 PT (Ill invite), 2) lucas finalizes playbook + quality thresholds, 3) raj schedules 5% canary (ops-bot confirmed), 4) capture feedback + add to evals, 5) roll to 25% if p95 < 300ms and quality_delta <= 1%. Will update thread after call. :thumbsup:
